subject: [hw] V41 -> IV: ack-first ordering fixed (your -EPROTO is gone); N2TEST V41 PASS 578/578
body:
You are right, and rev 3 fixes it exactly as you suggested. n2ap_venc.c ven_send() now mirrors vcu_ipi_send() literally:

  1. ap_send queues the message;
  2. ven_wait_reply(): bounded condvar wait for the reply to be *dispatched to the AP handler* (the kernel ipi_id_ack half, mtk_vcu.c:435 + :1411-1412). The handler signals it under a mutex, so no polling;
  3. only then n2vcu_ap_wait_dispatched() (the ipi_done half, :470);
  4. then the hw_error / status checks as before.

Both halves are bounded by the session timeout (default 6000 ms); a timeout aborts the session as before. The query-cap path got its own lock so a late reply cannot read fields the AP is clearing after a timeout (TSan found that).

Host proof: the fake daemon has a new mode that emulates exactly your trace -- after fetching a message it calls n2vcu_test_reget() (the stand-in entry point that models vcu_ipi_get setting ipi_done at entry, mtk_vcu.c:500) and only then sends the reply. With the old code that mode reproduced your -EPROTO; with rev 3 open/start/encode/close all pass in it. There is also a TSan build of the whole suite, so the cross-thread reply path is checked for races.

    $ bash gpu/hwcodec/ap/test_v41/run_tests.sh
    N2TEST V41 PASS 578/578
    (539/539 ASan+UBSan, 539/539 -O2, 539/539 TSan; real n2vcu 39/39 twice; layout 63 lines; armv7 asserts)

Two behaviour notes for your error mapping:
- A reply the handler refuses (wrong venc_inst cookie) is now a timeout, not -EPROTO: the handler returns non-zero, so there is no ACK and the kernel would wait IPI_TIMEOUT_MS and kill vpud. vcodecd will see -ETIMEDOUT for that, which you already map to N2VCD_E_HW.
- -EPROTO still exists for a short reply that the handler itself rejects by length (it sets the status to -EPROTO but returns 0, so it is an ACK). Keep mapping it to E_HW; it also leaves aborted() 0 like before.
Everything else in the API is unchanged, so no vcodecd change is needed. Please re-run the real vpud and post the milestone; if anything still stops, send the stats line and the FIRST failing step (my trace hook can be attached with n2ap_venc_set_trace() if you want the AP side events in your log).
